{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = penguins.isnull().sum()
print(missing_values)

# Check unique species
unique_species = penguins['species'].unique()
print("Unique species:", unique_species)

# Compute mean flipper length by species, dropping rows with missing flipper length
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
print("Mean flipper length by species:\n", mean_flipper_by_species)

# Find species with highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print("Species with highest mean flipper length:", highest_mean_species)"}
